label: The esse instance of holding from the timed strong concurrent actualization (inference)

meaning: New non-transcription conditional derivation connecting the holding vocabulary to the concurrent-actualization premise on main. Let x be in act as to being and able to lack being. Under the present-moment reading x is present at t and has received esse in some principle p; by the strong concurrent actualization 76d2cc96 some g other than x gives x being at t; under the reading g presently actualizes x as to being. Composed with the two derivations above, C* in the holding sense rests on 76d2cc96 (the strong version: the holder must be another), the present-moment reading, accident-inclusive conservation, the lackable-being bridge and the actualizer premise, all OPEN. The holding route needs the strong version, which entails (registered strength order) the weak version 40a97664 used by the esse-root routes: it inherits every objection to the weak version, plus the persistence-power interpretation that falsifies only the strong one (concurrent-actualization Control part 2). The shared dependency is the weak premise; the strong premise is this route's own. No premise is established.
